text: Michael and Susan Dell announce a $6.25 billion philanthropic commitment to seed investment accounts ("Trump Accounts") for 25 million U.S. children, specifically those born before 1/1/2025 and age 10 and under. This aligns with a new federal program launching 2026, which will grant $1,000 to accounts for children born 2025-2028.

meta.note: This is a top-tier structural event: economic architecture, continuity mechanics, and multi-actor alignment. Also, one of the largest philanthropic commitments to U.S. children in history.

text: MongoDB shares jumped 25% after huge Q3 beat (earnings + revenue), Atlas platform growth of 30% YoY, now 75% of total revenue, CEO Desai frames this as a "once-in-a-lifetime" inflection point across AI + cloud + data, raised full year guidance, and analysts lifting targets, citing AI demand + easing macro conditions.

meta.note: This is a pure expansion event inside the cloud + data stack, with an explicit inflection narrative. It confirms that the AI demand curve is shifting from surface-level consumer interfaces to deep infrastructure.

text: USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins warns that the federal government will cut off administrative funding to 19-21 Democratic-leaning states if they do not comply with federal demands to share full SNAP program data.

meta.note: This is not about SNAP fraud; it is an authority-alignment contest about data centralization and coercive leverage; affects federal authority structure, interstate relations, and national welfare infrastructure.
